scope: Operandi's logo: a stylized capital O with a fading grid, the original wordmark, and its app-icon derivatives. Branding assets only.

provenance.method: Modelled and rendered in Operandi itself (MCP bridge, Cycles) on 2026-11-10: a torus O with a gradient from the interface accent orange (sRGB 245, 158, 32, theme.rs ORANGE) to a warm cream (close to the old wordmark's 242, 231, 216), and a tube wireframe that fades in with the orange. Transparency comes from a separate white matte render. The wordmark is unchanged, copied from the 2026-10-22 logo (OP-LOGO-A2). Scenes and renders: ~/Developer/Operandi-Content/Logo-O (logo-o-orange-cream.opscene).
provenance.design_reference: The previous donut logo (OP-LOGO-A2, 2026-10-22) for layout and wordmark only.
provenance.approval: On 2026-11-10 the user chose the grid-fade O, first in deep blue, then asked for the interface orange and the earlier warm cream instead (the blue clashed with the UI), keeping the wordmark font and colour.
provenance.license: No project license or publication permission is assigned by this asset record.

assets.status: Operandi's logo since 2026-11-10 (replaces the donut OP-LOGO-A2). The O replaces the donut; the wordmark pixels are OP-LOGO-A2's.
Derived 2026-11-10 from the same render as OP-LOGO-B1.

assets.role: macOS 26+ Liquid Glass app icon (Icon Composer bundle): solid black fill, one layer = the OP-LOGO-APP-2 O cropped to its alpha bounds, 780 px on its longer side; system supplies glass, specular and shadow. Compiled into Assets.car as the bundle's icon Operandi (CFBundleIconName). The layer file keeps the name donut.png.
